transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I've been feeling extremely depressed and just completely empty for the past seven months. I have absolutely no motivation to do anything, and I've lost all interest in the activities I used to enjoy. It just feels like I can't drag myself out of this dark place.
Have you had periods of low mood like this before, and if so, how long did they last?
No, I don't recall ever having a period of low mood like this before now. This current emptiness started about seven months ago, and it has just been going on continuously since then.
Have you experienced any periods lasting at least two weeks where you felt little or no pleasure in almost all activities nearly every day?

Yes, absolutely. For the past seven months, I have felt completely unable to experience any joy or satisfaction in the things I do. It is like all the pleasure has been entirely drained out of my life, and nothing brings me happiness anymore.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yes, my appetite has been almost completely gone nearly every day for the past few months. Because of that, I've lost a significant amount of weight without even trying to diet. I just have to force myself to eat anything at all.
Have you been having trouble sleeping or sleeping too much nearly every day?
No, my sleep has actually been relatively normal. I haven't had any significant trouble falling asleep or sleeping too much. It's about the same as it has always been.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or the way you move, such as feeling slowed down or restless nearly every day?
I haven't really noticed feeling particularly slowed down or restless in my movements. I'm not really sure about any changes like that, other than just feeling generally drained from the depression.
